declarations.type:
∀ {current next : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.PartialRoute} {step : SearchRouteCost.RouteStep},
  SearchRouteInspectScheduler.ExtendsByOne current next step →
    SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialUncachedTokens next =
      SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialUncachedTokens current + step.evidenceTokens +
        (step.promptTokens - step.cachedPromptTokens)
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partial_uncached_tokens_extend

declarations.type:
∀ {current next : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.PartialRoute} {step : SearchRouteCost.RouteStep},
  SearchRouteInspectScheduler.ExtendsByOne current next step →
    SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialRounds next = SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialRounds current + step.roundCost
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partial_rounds_extend

declarations.type:
∀ {current next : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.PartialRoute} {step : SearchRouteCost.RouteStep},
  SearchRouteInspectScheduler.ExtendsByOne current next step →
    SearchRouteBranchBound.keyLexNoWorse (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialLowerBound current)
      (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialLowerBound next)
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partial_lower_bound_is_monotone

declarations.type:
∀ (left right : SearchRouteBranchBound.GraphLowerBound),
  SearchRouteInspectScheduler.keyLexNoWorseB left right = true ↔ SearchRouteBranchBound.keyLexNoWorse left right
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.keyLexNoWorseB_true_iff

declarations.type:
∀ (selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate) (frontiers : List SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier)
  (frontier : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier),
  frontier ∈ frontiers →
    frontier ∈ (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduleInspect selected frontiers).pruned ∨
      frontier ∈ (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduleInspect selected frontiers).inspect
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduleInspect_covers

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {frontiers : List SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier}
  {frontier : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier},
  frontier ∈ (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduleInspect selected frontiers).pruned →
    ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
      candidate ∈ frontier.candidates → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduled_pruning_is_safe

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {frontiers : List SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier}
  {frontier : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier},
  frontier ∈ (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduleInspect selected frontiers).inspect →
    ¬SearchRouteBranchBound.Prunable selected (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.partialLowerBound frontier.prefixRoute)
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduled_inspection_is_not_prunable

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {frontiers : List SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier},
  SearchRouteInspectScheduler.ScheduleComplete selected frontiers →
    ∀ (frontier : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier),
      frontier ∈ frontiers → frontier ∈ (SearchRouteInspectScheduler.scheduleInspect selected frontiers).pruned
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.completed_schedule_prunes_every_frontier

declarations.type:
∀ {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {candidateUniverse : SearchRouteBranchBound.CandidateUniverse}
  {visible : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  {frontiers : List SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier},
  SearchRouteBranchBound.VisibleOptimal selected visible →
    ∀ (receipt : SearchRouteBranchBound.CoverageReceipt candidateUniverse visible),
      receipt.deferred = List.map SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier.toCertifiedFrontier frontiers →
        SearchRouteInspectScheduler.ScheduleComplete selected frontiers →
          ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
            candidate ∈ candidateUniverse.candidates → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectScheduler.completed_inspect_schedule_is_globally_optimal
